decisions.reason: The accelerator program has stayed on the home page for two years at low cost and fits the firm's ecosystem strategy, and with the firm growing there is enough slack to carry it, though it sits furthest from the core machinery business.
The bio-based bitumen binder is a flagship with its own page in both years, so management sees no shortfall that would trigger search, and growth slack lets it carry this still-uncertain product.
The infectious waste plant is a flagship built with partner ERMAFA, close to the core offer and promoted more strongly over time, which signals that results meet aspirations.
